title: How to Create a Ticket from a New Communication with a Specific Sender

posts.name: vietthang
posts.cooked:
Issue Statement:

We are looking for a way to automate the creation of a new helpdesk ticket based on a new Communication record.

Issue Detailed Description:

A new ticket should be created in the helpdesk whenever a new Communication record is saved in our system. The key condition is that the from email address on the new communication must match one of our existing Email Accounts configured in Frappe.

For example, if we have an Email Account for support@example.com, and a new Communication is created with from_email='support@example.com', a new ticket should be generated from it.

Current behavior:

We have checked the standard Email Account settings, but they only seem to work for creating tickets from incoming emails, not from new Communication records created through other means (e.g., a custom script, API, etc.). We need this functionality to link communications from specific internal or system sources to our helpdesk.

Expected behavior:

Could you please provide guidance on how to achieve this? A Server Script on the Communication DocType seems like the most logical approach, but we need to know:

  • What is the correct before_insert or after_insert event to use?
  • What is the correct way to check if the from email exists in the Email Accounts DocType?
  • What is the proper Frappe API call to create a new HD Ticket and link it to the Communication?

Any assistance, including a code snippet or a link to relevant documentation, would be extremely helpful in implementing this custom workflow.
